Definition: {a she-goat (as strong), but masculine in plural (which also is used elliptically for goat's hair)}
BiblicalUsage: ʻêz means a she-goat. In Ezra 6:17, the text says "twelve he goats."
TheologicalSignificance: I take ʻêz as it stands: a she-goat.
